effects.clause: Cannot be used as Xyz or Link Material.

effects.clause: While Xyz Summoned, the opponent cannot attack other monsters.
effects.lua: EFFECT_CANNOT_SELECT_BATTLE_TARGET conditioned on SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ.

effects.clause: During damage calculation against a monster, ATK becomes that monster's ATK +100.
effects.lua: EFFECT_SET_ATTACK_FINAL during PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL using the battle target's ATK +100.

effects.clause: On an opponent's activation in a chain containing your effect, prevent responses and negate all other activated effects; draw based on your chain-link count and bottom-Deck a hand card if your effect was Chain Link 1.
effects.lua: EVENT_CHAINING validates both players in the chain, SetChainLimit(aux.FALSE) closes responses, NegateEffect iterates the earlier links, and the player/link counts gate the draw and hand return.

effects.clause: Send from hand and reduce a target's Level, Rank, or Link Rating by 1-3 until the end of the next turn.
effects.lua: Implements EFFECT_UPDATE_LEVEL and EFFECT_UPDATE_RANK only; Link monsters are not legal targets.
effects.notes: The bundled Omega constant/API corpus exposes no effect code that changes Link Rating. The printed Link Rating branch cannot be implemented faithfully in this runtime.

effects.clause: Special Summon from the GY while a monster has a reduced Level, Rank, or Link Rating, then banish this card when it leaves.
effects.lua: The reduced-value condition covers Level and Rank, and the summon applies EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT; the Link Rating condition is necessarily absent.

effects.clause: Discard; shuffle this card face-up into the opponent's Deck, also add a Stain card, then conditionally draw.
effects.lua: The face-up opponent-Deck move and search now resolve independently as required by 'also'; the later draw remains gated by successful addition and the field-count condition.

effects.clause: On Summon, bottom-Deck a GY/banished card or add your Stain card instead, and if successful shuffle this card.
effects.lua: Targets either public location, applies Necrovalley legality, offers the owner option, and gates the self-shuffle on the selected move succeeding.

effects.clause: On Summon, destroy an opponent's card and, if successful, shuffle this card into the Deck.
effects.lua: Duel.Destroy success gates the handler's shuffle.

effects.clause: From the GY, show a face-up Stain card, then shuffle this card face-up into the opponent's Deck, also add a Stain monster.
effects.lua: After a successful reveal, the self-move and search now resolve independently as required by 'also'.

effects.clause: If the opponent controls more cards, activate from hand to Special Summon this card.
effects.lua: Converted the non-chain Special Summon procedure to a HOPT hand Ignition Effect with condition, target legality, and resolution checks.

effects.clause: On Summon, negate another face-up card until the End Phase and, if successful, shuffle this card.
effects.lua: NegateAnyFilter and IsCanBeDisabledByEffect establish success before the temporary disable and handler shuffle.

effects.clause: Send a Level 4 or lower Stain monster from Deck as cost, then shuffle this card face-up into the opponent's Deck.
effects.lua: The Deck send is paid with REASON_COST and the handler move resolves through the shared face-up opponent-Deck helper.

effects.clause: On Summon, revive your Stain monster or an opponent's monster, then shuffle this card if the summon succeeds.
effects.lua: Controller-aware GY targeting, Necrovalley checks, and Special Summon success correctly gate the self-shuffle.

effects.clause: When this card battles, shuffle it face-up into the opponent's Deck, also after that put the opposing monster on top of the Deck.
effects.lua: Battle participants are captured and the later top-Deck action is correctly gated by the handler's successful move.

effects.clause: Reveal a Stain Fusion, move a Stain monster face-up into the opponent's Deck, also Special Summon this card.
effects.lua: The reveal is an activation cost; the Deck move and self-summon are attempted independently during resolution.

effects.clause: Move a qualifying controlled Stain monster face-up into the opponent's Deck, also add a Stain card from Deck, GY, or banishment.
effects.lua: The two 'also' actions resolve independently, with public-banishment and Necrovalley-safe GY filtering.

effects.clause: When a card leaves the opponent's Deck outside the Draw Phase, Tribute this card from hand or field to search a Stain card.
effects.lua: EVENT_MOVE checks previous Deck/controller state; the cost now uses Duel.Release from either location, matching official hand/field Tribute handling.

effects.clause: Banish this card from the GY to Special Summon a qualifying face-up Stain monster from the opponent's Deck.
effects.lua: The opponent-card condition, banish cost, face-up exact mention list, zone check, and destination controller all match the text.

effects.clause: Quick Fusion Summon during your Main Phase using qualifying Stain monsters from hand or field.
effects.lua: Turn/Main Phase condition, exact mention list, Fusion-material legality, material send, summon, and CompleteProcedure are present.

effects.clause: When sent to the GY, discard and send a Stain card from Deck to GY as cost, then add that sent card.
effects.lua: Both semicolon-separated payments occur in cost; the selected card is retained and only added if it remains legally accessible in the GY.
